findings.claim: Recovered Stage 1/2/3a/3b/4 agentic runner proxies bypass the current default benchmark-feature profile.
findings.scope: The public pin is post-paper and the scripts are historical-run proxies. This does not cryptographically prove that unreleased paper-run source bytes were identical.

findings.claim: AlphaEvolve Math, Symbolic Regression and AlgoTune have no distinct outer held-out test surface in the pinned public adapter.
findings.scope: The reported benchmark score may still be valid as a same-surface benchmark result; it is not a post-selection held-out generalization result.

findings.claim: TerminalBench Stage 4 has no adapter-level held-out final-test path.

evidence.base_contract: BenchmarkAdapter intentionally leaves evaluate_test absent on terminal_bench and swe_bench

findings.scope: This says no separate adapter-level test pass exists; it does not say TerminalBench task verification is absent.

findings.claim: CO-Bench, Symptom2Disease and LawBench have structurally distinct held-out test surfaces.

evidence.paper_table1: reports held-out test for CO-Bench, S2D and LawBench
evidence.co_bench_code: dev uses get_dev-selected indices; test uses the non-dev complement
evidence.classification_code: S2D uses dataset train-derived validation versus original dataset test; LawBench uses first 200 train, next max_val validation, remaining examples test

findings.claim: Held-out reporting is post-search, but archive-best held-out identity is not one universal frozen chain on multi-task benchmarks.

evidence.orchestrator_oracle_test: After evolution, _run_test_evaluation(tasks) takes archive.per_task_best_traces() and re-executes each stored winning script on held-out test cases.
evidence.orchestrator_single_chain_test: A separate post-search _run_chain_test_evaluation(tasks) evaluates archive.best_candidate as one candidate across all tasks.
evidence.paper_table1_reports_both: Meta^n archive-best and Meta^n best chain are separate estimators.

findings.material_clarification: For a multi-task benchmark such as 36-task CO-Bench, archive-best held-out is a dev-selected per-task portfolio mapping task->winning candidate, then one held-out re-evaluation of those stored scripts. It is not a single chain/router identity. Best-chain held-out is the single-candidate estimator. Reproducibility records should bind the full task->candidate source map for archive-best, not only one candidate id.
findings.scope: The test pass is still post-search in the inspected orchestrator path. This audit did not obtain the unpublished original paper-run summary/archive files, so exact historical task->candidate identities remain unbound.
